In this observational proteomic study, we used laser microdissection and mass spectrometry (LMD/MS) to determine the proteomic profile of podocyte proteins in kidney biopsies of adult patients with MCD (n = 6), pFSGS (n = 7), secondary FSGS (sFSGS) (n = 10), and genetic FSGS (gFSGS) (n = 6). Time-zero kidney transplant (T0) (n = 6), IgA nephropathy (IgAN) (n = 5) and membranous nephropathy (MN) (n = 8) served as nonproteinuric and proteinuric controls, respectively.
there was a significant loss of all 6 podocyte proteins in MCD, pFSGS, sFSGS, and gFSGS but not in MN cases.
